h1: Window cleaning in The Summit at Sweetwater
intro: The Summit at Sweetwater is the community's second gated section, with homes priced from $900K to $1.5M. CleanzATX cleans windows here, keeping a gate code on file and routing visits with neighbors.

sections.h2: What The Summit homes are like
paragraphs: Sweetwater has two gated parts, and The Summit is the second. Homes here fall between about $900,000 and $1.5 million, in the same price band as its sibling section Davenport Summit, and the Sweetwater HOA looks after it. This is a smaller pocket inside a large community, so you get the amenities of Sweetwater, like the pools, trails and clubs, with a gate between you and the through traffic.
Houses are newer, built as Sweetwater grew from the mid 2010s onward, so you find modern floor plans and large windows meant to bring in light.

sections.h2: What The Summit windows deal with
paragraphs: New builds in a growing community collect more than their share of dust. Construction in neighboring phases sends fine grit across the streets, and it lands on glass and frames, then locks on with dew. Fresh landscaping means irrigation overspray, and young lawns throw mineral spots at lower panes. Over a few seasons those can etch.

Pollen adds to the layer. The stucco and limestone should be soft washed rather than pressure washed, because high pressure drives water into the joints. Pure water dries clear without a film, which helps new dust slide off at the next rain.

We take the gate code in the quote, mark it on the job sheet, and text to confirm the day before. Then we usually combine The Summit with Davenport Summit and nearby open Sweetwater streets, so the gate is a one time entry for a short run of jobs. Many owners start with a full exterior and interior, then drop to a Triannual plan.

A 3,800 square foot house is a fair example. Exterior windows come to about $380, with around three to three and three quarter hours on site. Hand cleaning the inside at $15 a window brings it to about $570.

faq.q: Is The Summit at Sweetwater the same price as other areas?
faq.a: Our pricing is the same everywhere: $10 per window or about $0.10 per square foot for exterior, with a $200 minimum.

faq.q: Do you take care of builder residue on new windows?
faq.a: Yes. Stucco splatter, paint flecks and dust film can often be cleaned off during a first service. We look at each window before we start.

faq.q: Will you work with my gate rules?
faq.a: Yes. Send the code and any HOA quiet hours, and we plan the day around them.
Plans are discounts off the visit price: 10% for Twice a Year, 15% for Triannual and Quarterly, and 20% for Every 2 Months.

faq.q: What if I am away when you come?
faq.a: If the windows are exterior only, you do not need to be home. Tell us where pets are, and leave the gate open or the code with us.
